sessionKey.note: the user's own API key, held only for the session: memory, sessionStorage or chrome.storage.session, never a file, localStorage or a URL; dropped when the app, console or tab closes, or after ttlMinutes

stencil-server.note: base URL is the user-configured collaboration server; auth is the session bearer token

anthropicUpstream.note: the Messages API constants: the server's anthropic upstream (server/internal/llm) and every client's direct anthropic wire

cli.note: console waiter allows long local-model runs; unification to 120 deliberately deferred — change is one constant (cli/src/llm.zig request_timeout_ms)

browser.note: abort-driven (user stop button), no fixed chat deadline

serverDefaults.note: the Anthropic model and max_tokens defaults: the server env LLM_MODEL / LLM_MAX_TOKENS (server/internal/config) and the direct anthropic wire
